title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1966-05-19
source: Set 1 Source: sbd > 10 inch Master Reels @ 15 ips 1/2 track > Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of an early‑era show with good instrument separation but plagued by backward‑sounding drums and a missing second set.
ai_review.review: The SIRMick release offers clear instrument definition, especially on the opening "Beat It On Down The Line," giving listeners a vivid glimpse of early Garcia work. Unfortunately, aggressive noise reduction has rendered the drum track almost reversed, hurting the overall fidelity, and the recording omits the entire second set that appears on another source.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives a mid‑range 3‑star score; praise for instrument separation is offset by serious drum artifacts and the incomplete set, leading to an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Good instrument separation, but noise reduction introduces a backwards‑drum effect; drums sound unnatural and detract from clarity. No major issues noted for vocals or guitars.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down The Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is represented and praised, but the recording cuts off before the second set, which limits appreciation of the full concert flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's early‑era guitar work is highlighted positively on the opening track.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum sound suffers from noise reduction, making it appear as if played backwards.
